storyCards.headline: Broken Wings: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Mr. Mister's "Broken Wings" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 22 weeks on the chart.

Broken Wings was released in 1985.

Album: Welcome To The Real World (1985).

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
